g_policy.reason: The user opts in by tapping Play, the offer copy states the reward (priority routing, 60 minutes), declining leaves the menu unchanged, and the if-the-ad-fails field says the boost turns off if the game isn't finished.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority (queue_priority), which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event (returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry) and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal takes nothing away from free users; the 'removes nothing free' field is yes and it adds a temporary boost only.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the s09 profile menu sheet over s08, which is rated safe. It is not in a conversation or near unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Priority routing is sold as a Janitor+ benefit (l02 / s02.e06), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The idea depends on free users being in a 'normal queue', which is only inferred (m03, whose evidence s02.e07 is about swipes); the free-tier limit or queue priority is an open question. The trigger also assumes the user goes to an Upgrade screen and returns, and no such screen was observed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is a 60-minute sample capped at 2 per day, and memory, swipes and the badge stay behind Janitor+.

c5_moment.reason: The offer sits on the profile menu drawer, a persistent surface the user chooses to open, and does not interrupt a task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The if-the-ad-fails field says faster replies turn on when the user taps Play, so the reward is granted on a started ad instead of REWARD_VERIFIED.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry in the profile menu (s09.e31) and Janitor+'s priority routing benefit, which are specific to this app.

other_concern: The flow adds a new card and game screens, and step 4 puts a confirmation on My Chats. The trigger 'returns from Upgrade without subscribing' may not be reliably detectable. Enabling the boost before verification could also be abused.
